page.overview:
What is Chainsaw Man Part 2?

Chainsaw Man Part 2 belongs to Chainsaw Man. The |Gakkō Hen}} is the second and final part of the Chainsaw Man series. Part 2 was serialized in the Shonen Jump+ platform since July 13, 2022 until March 25, 2026. It is preceded by the Public Safety Saga. It follows Asa Mitaka, host of the War Devil Yoru, as she attempts to locate Chainsaw Man who is enrolled in the same high school as her.

Also known as: Part 2, Academy arc, School arc.
